rationale: Reallocates the tail FP16 export budget away from recurrent-tail Q and toward recurrent-tail K/V while preserving final-block Q. This is a compact, final-metric-targeted change on top of the current recurrent-tail baseline: it directly changes the exact int8+zlib roundtrip path, follows the strongest local near-miss category around value-path float rescue, and slightly reduces artifact pressure versus keeping Q on every recurrent block.
title: Recurrent-Tail Value-Path FP16 Reallocation
